rows.en: I look forward to working with you!
Annie, this is Earth.
It looks so much like my home…

I won't let Fuuma do as they please!

Annie, what about your family?

My parents and one little sister… Papa was a police chief.

What about your family, Shaider? You never tell me…
My parents both died when I was little. I was raised by my grandma. And she's gone too…
I see… So you were all alone too, Shaider.
We can't let Earth end up like Planet Mount!

Yes… Earth is my second home! I won't hand it over to Fuuma, not this time!

We're both all alone, aren't we?
Yeah…
In their first real battle, Shaider and Annie watched their senior, Gavan, fight right before their eyes, and felt keenly how inexperienced they were.
The inexperienced Space Sheriffs have no choice but to keep helping each other. To fight the terrifying Fuuma, Shoketsu, Space Sheriff Shaider!!
Hongooo!!
Hongooo!!
Retsuuu!!
Gavaaan!!
Dai!!
Daaai!!
Hmph… Today I only came to probe you, but next time, you'd better be ready!
Curse you, Gavan!! But I… I will never die until I've defeated you!
Defeat Commander Hessler and all Miracler Soldiers!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers, Sai Doubler, Commander Hessler and Miracler Soldiers!
Defeat all Crusher Soldiers, Sai Doubler, Commander Hessler and Miracler Soldiers! Also seize the laboratory and the factory!
Takeshi Hongo or Retsu Ichijouji is defeated
Takeshi Hongo, Retsu Ichijouji or Dai Sawamura is defeated
<c3>Hayata</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Hayata</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
Among the TDF's external support organizations was a special unit called the "Science Patrol".
They specialized in investigating strange incidents and anomalies, and bore the grave duty of defending the Earth from every outside threat, kaiju and aliens alike.
4 a.m., Ryugamori, Saitama Prefecture…
Science Patrol member Hayata was flying a routine patrol in a Jet VTOL.
Hayata to HQ… Hayata to HQ!
Yes, this is HQ… What's the matter? Why do you sound like that?
I've spotted an unidentified flying object over Ryugamori!
All right, continue pursuit and confirm what it is. We'll move out as soon as we hear from you.
Roger. I'll move in closer and get a good look at it.
Yes, Science Patrol HQ.

This is the Saitama Prefectural Police patrol unit. Emergency report!!

About 15 minutes ago, a red sphere and a blue sphere giving off a weird glow flew into Ryugamori one after the other…
A weird what?

…A weird glow, a strange light.

Flashing like crazy, the blue sphere fell into the lake, and the red one collided with a flying object passing overhead… and came down in Ryugamori.
Huh… a flying object!? Hey, did it really collide!?
Some students who were camping saw it happen!
Fuji, call Hayata!

Y-yes, sir! HQ to Hayata… HQ to Hayata!

Hayata, respond! Hayata… Hayata, please respond!
Prepare to move out!
I'm sorry… for malfunctioning at a time like this…

Don't worry about it…

With this much heavy fighting going on… even you can't say it hasn't affected you, right?

Yes…

The startup check will be finished soon. I hope nothing happens before then…
Ah, Mr. Tachibana…
Where are Hayato and Taki?
Where are Hongo and Taki?
They haven't come in yet today…
Just as I thought… Now that I know that, I can't sit around taking it easy either!
Oyassan… what's got you in such a rush?
You should at least read the newspaper!
What's that supposed to mean? Seriously…

This must be it…

It says "Science Patrol Member Missing!? Mysterious Glow Appears!!"… The location is Ryugamori in Saitama Prefecture.
The Science Patrol!?
Yes… It's a special unit called the Science Patrol. I've heard it's one of the TDF's external support organizations.
The guys who deal with kaiju and aliens, huh… So… something like the Ultra Garrison?
But… it's worrying, isn't it?
Ryugamori, huh… All right, let's join the search too!
[HERO4]… eating that much is bad for your health, you know? And it's bad for your looks, too…
Autumn's the season for eating, and anyway, appetite is the barometer of health! In other words, I'm totally healthy right now…
They haven't come in yet today…
Oyassan… what's got you in such a rush?
What on earth… could've happened?

This is it…

It says "Science Patrol Member Missing!? Mysterious Glow Appears!!"… It's at Ryugamori in Saitama.
Yeah… It's a special unit called the Science Patrol. I heard it's one of the TDF's external support organizations…
An organization that deals with kaiju and aliens, huh… So… something like the Ultra Garrison?
But… it's worrying, huh?

Sure.

But wait a sec, let me finish eating this…
"It should be somewhere around here…"

…!?

It's completely wrecked, but… it's Hayata's VTOL, all right. Nobody could've survived this…

But… isn't it strange that Hayata's body isn't here?

Cap, let's look for Hayata. He might still be alive!
Right, let's split up and search for Hayata!

…!?

[HERO2], [HERO4]! What are you doing here?
Goro!? Are you searching for the Science Patrol member too?

No…

I got word that the Neo-Humans are rounding up construction workers all over the place! And it looks like it's somewhere around here…
What!? The Neo-Human Empire?

uncertain: U03215: そのお婆ちゃんも… left unfinished in Japanese; rendered 'And she's gone too…' (implied death).
U03231/U03232: garbled conditions decoded as in B0039 (指症撃=指揮官, 報方員=戦闘員, 嘸仕悪と掛通 guessed laboratory/factory).
U03248/U03249: pun on カイコウ (怪光 heard as an unfamiliar word) adapted as 'A weird what?'.
U03282: whole line in 『』 (Goro's thought/voice) rendered in double quotes to keep the distinction.
U03283: ビートル rendered 'VTOL' per glossary ジェットビートル = Jet VTOL.

new_names.why: following 新人類帝国 = Neo-Human Empire

glyph_suspects.likely: 兵士クラッシャー / 指揮官 / 戦闘員 / 全て / 研究所と工場(?) / 制圧
